deploymentState.deploymentNotes: v3: bounded surplus-band delete (was capped at 20), string PARTIAL_WRITE compare, value range-check, + description/tags/unitType/label/version fields. Suite 40/40. Approved by avinash.baraiya

description: GET, CREATE or UPDATE one rate table with its bands (basis points; last band may be open-ended). Refuses before writing: INVALID_INPUT, RATE_TABLE_INVALID (first band at 0, contiguous, non-overlapping), DUPLICATE_NAME, NOT_FOUND. Writes parent and bands with deterministic ids so a retry is idempotent; a half-landed write answers PARTIAL_WRITE naming the rateTableId to retry with. Stores description, tags, unit type, per-band labels and version info (version 1, effective from creation, End of Time). Serves the Reference Tables create/edit screens.
